description: Rules in input (X) space, purity measured against the network output (model predictions). band_lo/band_hi are bias-absorbed: check band_lo <= w*x <= band_hi. null=unbounded. No sparsification: each condition uses the full first-layer weight_vector. Fallback mode: tree.

fallback.description: a shallow CART (max_depth=4) trained on the uncovered training samples; predicts uncovered inputs with comparisons only (no multiplies).
